Insight pointers

Data-backed speaking points for the brand team.

01

Prevention and correction are almost equally important sunscreen jobs.

Protection / prevention18 / 45
Problem solution / correction17 / 45

Pointer: Sunscreen communication should protect against future damage while addressing visible concerns.

Consumer verbatim: “I bought it to prevent tanning, but I still noticed tanning after using it.”
02

The biggest experience gap is not efficacy alone; it is visible proof of prevention.

Expected prevention18 / 45
Actual prevention result11 / 43
No noticeable difference12 / 43

Pointer: Make protection benefits easier to notice, understand and validate in everyday use.

Consumer verbatim: “I expected it to prevent tanning, but I could not clearly see that difference.”
03

Clinical credibility is a strong brand association alongside skincare language.

Dermatologist11
Skincare11
Clinical5

Pointer: Keep dermatologist and clinical proof visible while translating it into simple consumer benefits.

Consumer verbatim: “The brand feels clinical and dermatologist-backed, but still easy to understand.”
